from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document with its title and case cause type."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this judgment document")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The legal case cause/type as stated in the document, e.g. '行政处罚', '行政给付', '刑事犯罪'")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document, e.g. '行政裁定书', '行政判决书', '刑事判决书'")
    matches_administrative_payment: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this document is identified as '行政行为-行政给付' type based on the case cause")
    summary: str | None = Field(description="Brief summary of the document's content")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
